d: In this episode of Rajdoot, we examine the dramatic final 24 hours of Jensen Huang's tenure as Nvidia CEO, the allegations surrounding his personal life, and the political battle that erupted inside the Trump administration over his future. Why did Donald Trump personally urge Huang not to step down? Why did Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Secretary of State Marco Rubio clash with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over Nvidia's business with China? What role did Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed play in the growing controversy? And could Lutnick lose his cabinet position…
